2609.01567.title: Selective Agent Guidance via Entropy: Learning Autonomous Policies from Imperfect VLM Teachers
2609.01567.paper_summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide useful priors for interactive decision-making, but using them directly as policies is expensive and brittle: they must be queried at every step, do not improve from environment interaction, and can repeat systematic errors. We study how to learn a cheap autonomous policy from an online, expensive, and imperfect but informative VLM teacher. We propose SAGE (Selective Agent Guidance via Entropy), a framework that queries a VLM only when the learner is uncertain, executes the suggested action during training, and distills guidance into a lightweight Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy. Because VLM advice is not always reliable, SAGE can weight teacher-action distillation using environment-derived advantages rather than treating all suggestions as equally useful. Across sparse-reward visual reasoning and navigation tasks, SAGE learns policies that act without VLM guidance at evaluation time and improves over unguided RL in several environments, including settings where the learned policy exceeds its VLM teacher. The results show that selective guidance is most beneficial when the VLM can help the agent discover high-reward trajectories, and less useful when unguided exploration already succeeds or teacher actions do not lead to informative experience. SAGE also reduces VLM usage by prompting the teacher only on a fraction of training steps and requiring no VLM calls at deployment. Overall, our results suggest that VLMs don't need to be used as fixed policies to be useful; they can instead act as temporary, imperfect sources of guidance whose value is tested and internalized through interaction.
2609.01567.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言模型（VLMs）為互動決策提供了有用的先驗知識，但直接將它們用作政策是昂貴且脆弱的：它們必須在每一步都被查詢，並且不會從環境互動中改進，還可能重複系統性錯誤。我們研究如何從一個在線的、昂貴的、雖然不完美但信息豐富的 VLM 教師那裡學習一個便宜的自主政策。我們提出了 SAGE（通過熵的選擇性代理指導），這是一個僅在學習者不確定時查詢 VLM 的框架，在訓練期間執行建議的行動，並將指導提煉成輕量級的強化學習（RL）政策。由於 VLM 的建議並不總是可靠的，SAGE 可以使用環境導出的優勢來加權教師行動的提煉，而不是將所有建議視為同樣有用。在稀疏獎勵的視覺推理和導航任務中，SAGE 學習的政策在評估時無需 VLM 指導而行動，並在幾個環境中超越了無指導的 RL，包括學習的政策超過其 VLM 教師的情況。結果顯示，當 VLM 能夠幫助代理發現高獎勵軌跡時，選擇性指導最有利，而當無指導的探索已經成功或教師行動未能帶來有益的經驗時，則不太有用。SAGE 還通過僅在一部分訓練步驟中提示教師來減少 VLM 的使用，並在部署時不需要 VLM 調用。總體而言，我們的結果表明，VLM 不需要作為固定政策來發揮作用；它們可以作為臨時、不完美的指導來源，其價值通過互動進行測試和內化。
